# ChatCart

> ChatCart is a chat-first social commerce marketplace for Nigeria. Buyers discover
> local products in a full-screen video feed, message sellers with the exact item
> already attached, agree a price through offers and counter-offers, and pay into
> escrow that releases to the seller only when the order is received.

ChatCart is a mobile app (Android and iOS) serving Nigeria. Pricing is in naira.
Sign-in is required to buy, sell or message.

## How the money works

- The buyer pays in full at checkout. The payment is held, not forwarded to the seller.
- The seller has 24 hours to accept an order. If they do not, the order is cancelled
  and the buyer is refunded automatically.
- The seller ships and marks the order as sent, which starts the release clock.
- Funds release when the buyer confirms delivery, or automatically 48 hours after the
  order is marked as sent if the buyer neither confirms nor disputes.
- Opening a dispute freezes the payment instead of releasing it.
- Refunds return through the payment processor to the original payment method. The
  platform returns the money immediately; the buyer's bank controls when it appears.
- ChatCart earns a commission from the seller on completed orders, deducted at release,
  at the rate in effect when the order was placed. There is no separate escrow fee to
  buyers today.
- Escrow is a payment hold inside a marketplace. It is not a bank deposit account and
  it is not insurance, and ChatCart does not describe it as either.

## Key pages

- [Home](https://chatcart.app/): what ChatCart is and how to get the app.
- [How it works](https://chatcart.app/how-it-works): the full buyer and seller journey, order states and timings.
- [Escrow](https://chatcart.app/escrow): how the payment hold works, disputes, refunds and fees.
- [Marketplace chat](https://chatcart.app/chat): messaging that carries the item, photos and price into the thread.
- [Offers](https://chatcart.app/offers): offers, counter-offers, 72-hour expiry and agreed pricing.
- [Social commerce](https://chatcart.app/social-commerce): how discovery works and where the DM-to-payment handover fails.
- [For sellers](https://chatcart.app/for-sellers): listing, order management, commission and payouts.
- [For buyers](https://chatcart.app/for-buyers): paying safely, confirming delivery and raising a dispute.
- [FAQ](https://chatcart.app/faq): short answers on payments, delivery, refunds and payouts.

## Coverage

Nigeria: Lagos, Abuja, Kano, Port Harcourt, Ibadan and Kaduna.
